en: Thunderstorms occur only in spring and summer

zh: 春夏才有雷雨 · J 换季
en: Thunderstorms occur only in spring and summer · J Change season

zh: 行走 · F 切回旁观
旁观 · F 切回行走
流逝暂停 · P 继续
旁观时的视野角度。越大看得越广，画面边缘的拉伸也越明显。
en: Field of view while flying. Wider shows more, with more stretching near the edges.

zh: 行走时的视野角度。容易晕时可以调大一些。
en: Field of view while walking. A wider view can help if you feel motion sick.

zh: 行走时镜头随步伐起伏的幅度。容易晕时可以调低或关闭。
en: How much the camera bobs with each step while walking. Lower it or turn it off if you feel motion sick.

zh: 漫游时在画面一角显示帧率、帧时、显卡与内存占用等读数。
en: While exploring, shows frame rate, frame time, GPU and memory readings in a corner of the screen.

zh: 不保存 · 已关闭存档
不保存 · 另一个窗口正在运行
en: Not saving · Another window is running

zh: 关闭最上层 / 打开设置
下一种天气（按住 0.6 s 自动）
时间只往前走，没有倒退键。Esc 不暂停世界；暂停流逝用 P。数字键 1–9、0 跳到点位 P01–P09、P00。
en: Time only moves forward. Esc does not pause the world; press P to pause time. Number keys 1–9 and 0 jump to points P01–P09 and P00.

zh: 预设只管效果项：光影、植被、水与粒子。显示、清晰度与镜头舒适项保持你的选择。改动任一效果项即为“自定义”。
en: Presets set the effect options only: lighting, vegetation, water and particles. Display, clarity and comfort options keep your choices. Changing any effect option makes it Custom.

zh: 改动任一效果项后自动成为自定义
en: Becomes Custom when you change an effect option

zh: 描线、分阶明暗与按材质的影色、柔光、平涂贴图、实时阴影与西湖倒影是本作画风，任何画质下都保留。
en: Outlines, stepped shading, material-tinted shadows, soft light, flat textures, real-time shadows and West Lake reflections define the visual style and remain enabled at every quality level.

zh: {n} 项待应用 · 通过加载界面应用
en: {n} changes pending · Applied through the loading screen

zh: {n} 项待应用 · 下次启动生效
已保存 · 下次启动生效
有项目超出范围，没有改动
en: Some values are out of range; nothing changed
This page already uses the defaults

zh: 把指针移到一项上，或用方向键选中它，这里显示它的作用、生效方式和负载。
en: Point at an option or select it with the arrow keys to see what it does, when it applies and what it costs.

zh: 窗口、无边框全屏或独占全屏。无边框切出游戏更顺；独占全屏由游戏独占显示器。
en: Windowed, borderless or exclusive fullscreen. Borderless switches away more smoothly; exclusive fullscreen gives the game the whole display.

zh: 窗口模式下的窗口尺寸；全屏时不起作用。
en: Window size in windowed mode; has no effect in fullscreen.

zh: 让画面与显示器刷新同步，避免撕裂。关闭后延迟略低，但转动镜头时可能出现撕裂。
en: Syncs frames to the display refresh to prevent tearing. Turning it off lowers latency slightly, but the image may tear when the camera turns.

zh: 每秒最多渲染多少帧。越高越流畅，显卡负载与功耗也越高。“跟随刷新率”由垂直同步限帧；切到后台时降到每秒 30 帧。
en: The most frames rendered per second. Higher is smoother but raises GPU load and power use. Refresh rate is capped by VSync; in the background the game drops to 30 frames per second.

zh: 3D 画面按输出分辨率的多少渲染。低于 100% 时先在较低分辨率渲染、再用 FSR 1 放大，帧率更高，细线会变软。界面文字不受影响。
en: How much of the output resolution the 3D view renders at. Below 100% it renders smaller and upscales with FSR 1: higher frame rate, softer fine lines. Interface text is unaffected.

zh: 内部 {output} · 与输出一致，不放大
平滑物体边缘的锯齿。SMAA 边缘更干净；FXAA 更省，但细线会略糊。
en: Smooths jagged edges. SMAA keeps edges cleaner; FXAA is cheaper but blurs fine lines slightly.

zh: 阴影贴图的分辨率与级数。越高阴影边缘越清楚，显存与显卡负载越高。
en: Shadow map resolution and cascade count. Higher gives crisper shadow edges, with more video memory and GPU load.

zh: 多远以内的物体投下实时阴影。越远远景越立体，显卡负载越高。
en: How far away objects still cast real-time shadows. Farther gives distant scenery more depth, with more GPU load.

zh: 树丛与草的密度。调低后植被更稀疏，处理器与显卡负载更低。
en: Density of shrubs and grass. Lower is sparser, with less CPU and GPU load.

zh: 水面倒影每隔几帧更新一次。间隔越大越省，快速移动时倒影略有滞后。
en: How often water reflections update, in frames. Longer intervals are cheaper, but reflections lag slightly when moving fast.

zh: 雨、雪与飘落物的数量。调低后更省，天气效果更稀疏。
en: Amount of rain, snow and falling leaves. Lower is cheaper, with sparser weather effects.

zh: FSR 1 放大后的锐化程度。数值越大越锐利，0 最弱；渲染精度低于 100% 时才起作用。
en: Sharpening applied after FSR 1 upscaling. Higher values are sharper, 0 is the weakest; only applies below 100% render resolution.

zh: 渲染精度为 100% 时不放大，锐化不起作用
en: At 100% render resolution nothing is upscaled, so sharpening has no effect

zh: 画面四角轻微压暗，是本作镜头风格的一部分。关闭后四角保持原有亮度。
en: Gently darkens the corners of the image as part of the camera style. Turn it off to keep the corners at full brightness.

zh: 点一项后按下新键；Esc 取消。一个键只能绑一个动作，冲突时不改。
en: Select an action, then press a new key; Esc cancels. Each key can bind to only one action. Conflicting bindings are left unchanged.
This key is already bound to “{action}”
Could not enter. Please try again.

zh: 最近的进度没能保存，继续将回到 {saved} 的存档。
en: Recent progress could not be saved. Continue will return to the save from {saved}.
Recent progress could not be saved.

zh: 没能恢复存档，已回到开始页，请重试或开始新游戏。
en: Could not restore the save. Returned to the title screen. Try again or start a new game.

zh: 磁盘空间不足，这次没有保存。
en: Not enough disk space, so nothing was saved.

zh: 没有写入存档文件夹的权限，这次没有保存。
en: No permission to write to the save folder, so nothing was saved.

zh: 读写存档文件时出错，这次没有保存。
en: A file error stopped the save.

zh: 写完后校验没通过，这次的存档作废，之前的存档仍可用。
en: The new save failed verification and was discarded; earlier saves are still available.

zh: 没能记录当前状态，这次没有保存。
en: Could not capture the current state, so nothing was saved.

zh: 保存超时，这次没有存完。
en: Saving timed out and did not finish.

zh: 这个存档位来自更新版本，本版本不写入。
en: This slot was made by a newer version and is not written by this one.

zh: 这个存档位读不出，未经确认不会写入。
en: This slot cannot be read and is not written without confirmation.

zh: 这个存档位是空的。在这里开始新游戏，之后会一直自动保存到这里。
en: This slot is empty. Start a new game here; your progress will then be saved here automatically.

zh: 游玩时自动保存到这里；最新的进度读不出时，会退回上一次保存的进度。
en: Progress is saved here automatically. If the newest save cannot be read, the previous one is used instead.

zh: 存档文件损坏，无法读取
en: The save file is damaged and cannot be read

zh: 新游戏 · 选择存档位
en: New game · Choose a save slot

zh: 这个存档位已有进度。开始新游戏会替换它，旧进度不再保留。
en: This slot already has progress. Starting a new game will replace it permanently.

zh: 存档文件损坏，无法读取。可以覆盖它重新开始。
en: The save file is damaged and cannot be read. You can overwrite it to start again.

zh: 存档位 {slot} 里现有的进度会被新游戏替换，此后无法找回。
en: Existing progress in slot {slot} will be replaced by the new game and cannot be recovered.

zh: 存档位 {slot} 的存档已无法读取，覆盖后文件将被替换。
en: The save in slot {slot} can no longer be read. Overwriting will replace its files.

zh: 这个存档来自更新版本的游戏。为了不损坏它，本版本不读取也不写入；确认后仍可覆盖它开始新游戏，或删除整个存档位。
en: This save comes from a newer version of the game. To keep it safe, this version will not load or write to it. You can still confirm to overwrite it with a new game or delete the whole slot.

zh: 自动 {auto} 份 · 手动 {manual} 份
这局游戏不写入存档位
en: This session does not write to a save slot

zh: 手动存档已满 {limit} 份。立即保存会替换最旧的一份，被替换的存档无法找回。
en: Manual saves are full ({limit}). Saving now will replace the oldest one, which cannot be recovered.

zh: 存档位 {slot} 的全部存档会被删除，此后无法找回。
en: All saves in slot {slot} will be deleted and cannot be recovered.

zh: 存档位 {slot} 的全部存档会被删除，连同 {manual} 份手动存档，此后无法找回。
en: All saves in slot {slot}, including {manual} manual saves, will be deleted and cannot be recovered.

zh: 存档位 {slot} 里的这份手动存档会被删除，此后无法找回。
en: This manual save in slot {slot} will be deleted and cannot be recovered.

zh: 存档位 {slot} 里现有的进度会被新游戏替换，连同 {manual} 份手动存档，此后无法找回。
en: Existing progress in slot {slot}, including {manual} manual saves, will be replaced by the new game and cannot be recovered.
Saves cannot be deleted right now.

zh: 滚轮 缩放 · 拖动 平移 · G 目录 · Esc 返回
en: Wheel Zoom · Drag Pan · G Index · Esc Back
